instruction.text: What do you know about South Africa? Complete the fact file.

end.text: South Africa has 12 official languages: Afrikaans, English, isiZulu, South African Sign Language, isiXhosa, Sepedi, Setswana, Sesotho, Xitsonga, Siswati, Tshivenda and isiNdebele.
